data.raw_text:
You erased Nanjing.
You erased Manila.
You erased Unit 731.

Then you dare to “remember” Tiananmen?
History isn’t your morality play.

Every tweet, every tearful “human rights” monologue, every trembling mention of “Tiananmen” isn’t activism.
It’s content.

The West built an entire market for sin redemption, and these people became its street preachers.
You don’t believe in freedom.
You believe in tips.

You chant “truth,” while linking your Buy Me a Coffee.
You mourn “the oppressed,” while living off the currency of pity.
You call it awareness; we call it performance.

Your audience isn’t listening for justice.
You’re buying absolution.
Every “brave dissident” is just another confessional booth,a place where the guilty West whispers,
“Tell me China is evil, so I can feel good again.”

These self-anointed prophets of democracy
don’t know the languages you claim to defend.
You can’t tell Nanjing from Manila, Unit 731 from Hiroshima.
You know only one language, the price of Western guilt in U.S. dollars.

And when you say “freedom,” what you mean is monetization.
When you say “truth,” what you mean is traffic.
When you say “solidarity,” what you mean is sponsorship.

You are not victims of ideology.
You are entrepreneurs of it.
And hatred has become your brand.

You don’t speak truth to power. 
You sell it to subscribers.
